title: Review: da4733c decode_limited exact-limit fix
notes:
Section 0: No correctness bugs found. P0 fix (>= to >) is correct and does not regress any adjacent case. Traced exact-limit, zero-limit, over-limit, multi-line, malformed-line-at-boundary, empty-block-at-zero-limit. All correct. decode() delegation to decode_limited(None) is behaviorally identical (usize::MAX sentinel is safe).
Maintainer risk: LOW — No new public API, no new footguns, no security surface. The decode() -> decode_limited(None) refactor eliminates maintenance burden. The complexity note update is accurate. The decode_uuencode heuristic fragility was already documented and is not changed by this commit.
Confidence: 5% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: (1) the zero-limit+empty-block case (traced carefully, correct but untested). (2) the ambiguous heuristic case where encoding error at exact limit boundary misclassifies as input_was_limited — pre-existing, not changed. Uncertainty driven by: not having run under MIRI; not having a fuzz harness specifically for the exact-limit path. Would raise confidence if: added decode_limited_zero_limit_empty_block test and ran cargo-fuzz for 5 minutes on decode_limited.
